title: Uptime Monitor API results
description: One row per URL: up, healthy, healthIssues, statusCode, responseTimeMs, httpStatusExpected, responseTimeOk, sslValid, sslDaysToExpiry, finalUrl, redirected, probes (apify and eu-gate attempts), fromCache, error, errorType. Charged: delivered URL observations (an unreachable public website is a billed observation). Not charged: invalid URLs, non-public targets, cached observations.
